name: entry_number
description: CBP entry number as printed in box 1, e.g. 8NW-1591298-8 - natural key, one row per entry

name: filer_code
description: First three characters of the entry number: the customs broker's CBP filer code

name: entry_type_detail
description: Box 2 qualifier printed after the code, e.g. ABI/P

name: summary_date
description: Box 3 - date the entry summary was filed

name: entry_date
description: Box 7 - date of entry. Decides which fiscal year's MPF minimum/maximum applies

name: port_code
description: Box 6 - port of entry (2704 = Los Angeles)

name: bill_of_lading
description: Box 12 - master B/L. Join key to drayage, demurrage and Yusen invoices

name: broker_name
description: Box 46 - customs broker that filed the entry

name: po_numbers
description: PO numbers from the box 47 reference (Ref: PO#...)

name: shipment_type
description: stock (own inventory) or amazon_di (Amazon Direct Import) - valued differently, so value checks branch on it. Null when not yet known

name: total_entered_value
description: Box 39 - total entered value as declared on the form

name: other_fees
description: Box 43 - MPF + HMF + any other fees

name: total
description: Box 44 - duty + tax + other. What the importer owes CBP for this entry

name: fees
description: Other Fee Summary for block 43, as charged (MPF here is after the min/max is applied)

fields.name: code
fields.description: CBP class code, e.g. 499 MPF, 501 HMF

fields.name: description
fields.description: Merchandise description: that of the line's commodity (non chapter 99) tariff, else the line heading

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Commercial invoice the line belongs to

fields.name: entered_value
fields.description: Sum of the line's tariff entered values (chapter 99 rows carry 0)

fields.name: charges
fields.description: Box 36B - freight and other charges excluded from entered value

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Rate as printed: 12.5%, Free, or a specific rate

fields.name: line_fees
fields.description: Per-line MPF / HMF before the entry-level MPF min/max

name: commercial_invoices
description: Commercial invoice reconciliation printed on the continuation sheet

fields.name: duty_deduction
fields.description: (-) Duty, Fees and Taxes - the duty the invoice price assumed, e.g. on DDP terms

name: validation_status
description: ok, or flagged when any check below raised a flag. Errors never load without --allow-mismatch

name: validation_findings
description: Every check that did not pass, as of load time

fields.name: severity
fields.description: error (the form does not add up - usually a parse problem), flag (the entry looks wrong), info

name: raw_text
description: Full layout text extracted from the PDF - the safety net for anything not mapped above

name: source_sha256
description: SHA-256 of the PDF. Same entry + same hash = already loaded

name: ingested_by
description: gcloud account that ran the load
